Paper [18] discusses systematic bias in machine learning regression models, including underestimation of large-valued outcomes, which aligns with the concept of intensity underestimation. Thus, the mechanism is covered by [8].

This matches the evaluation design of analyzing prediction errors relative to thresholds. Therefore, the evaluation is covered by [8].

The domain is "precipitation nowcasting failure analysis." Several prior papers, including [2], [4], [5], [6], [10], [12], [14], and [15], work in the general area of precipitation nowcasting. While none of these papers focus specifically on failure analysis, they all operate within the same application area of precipitation nowcasting. Thus, the domain is covered.
